# Accessibility Nutrition Labels

<!-- Generated by scripts/a11y_labels.py from what the repo proves. The text
     between the a11y-labels:generated markers is rewritten on every run;
     anything you write outside them is kept. -->

What to answer in App Store Connect → your app → App Accessibility, one line per
feature. Claim only what says **supported**: each one names the checks behind it,
and the `ship` skill copies these answers and nothing more. Larger Text means
people can finish the common tasks with text at 200% or more.

<!-- a11y-labels:generated -->
- **VoiceOver**: not yet claimed (missing: docs/product/SCREENS.md, the list of common tasks the prototype freeze writes)
- **Voice Control**: not yet claimed (missing: docs/product/SCREENS.md, the list of common tasks the prototype freeze writes)
- **Larger Text**: not yet claimed (missing: docs/product/SCREENS.md, the list of common tasks the prototype freeze writes)
- **Sufficient Contrast**: supported (evidence: check_contrast.py: every text pair clears WCAG AA in every mode)
- **Reduced Motion**: supported (evidence: lib/motion.ts: presets carry ReduceMotion.System; loops check useReducedMotion; check-a11y.js: no animation outside lib/motion.ts ignores Reduce Motion)
- **Dark Interface**: supported (evidence: design/tokens.json has a dark palette that check_contrast.py also checks)
- **Differentiate Without Color Alone**: not yet claimed (missing: a check that no screen carries meaning in colour alone; nothing proves it yet)
- **Captions**: not applicable unless the app has video (no video player in mobile/)
- **Audio Descriptions**: not applicable unless the app has video (no video player in mobile/)
<!-- /a11y-labels:generated -->

To claim a feature that says "not yet claimed", make its missing evidence true
(a check, a flow, a palette), then run `python3 scripts/a11y_labels.py`.
